style: crisp pixel art in the style of Ragnarok Online skill icons: clean dark outlines, bright saturated colours, broad flat pixel clusters, high contrast
how: generate_image purpose project_art, square, quality medium, px 1024, this style and prompt; then python3 tools/skill_icons.py <sheet.png> 4 4 <ids...>
